correctness.rationale: For R(p) cyclically equal to p, height increment +1 corresponds to a coprime positional shift; its modular inverse forces p_j=p_0+js, with gcd(s,N)=1. For each adjacent pair the height difference is ±s mod N. Necessary crossing-exchange differences d±1 force 2=(epsilon−eta)s mod odd N; either equal signs are impossible or s=±1, where adjacent differences 1,N−1 cannot be separated by 2 for odd N≥5. Deletion occurs exactly at s=±1; S is cyclic conjugate of p_s. Thus exactly phi(N) fixed classes, phi(N)−2 deletion-free, and petal decrease needs T+ first. No false knot-minimality assertion.
